idea-plugin.name: Live Background
idea-plugin.description:
Plays a video as the background of the IDE, behind the whole window or just the editors.

  • Videos and images: mp4, webm, mov, mkv, avi, gif, apng, jpg, png, webp and more.
  • Folder rotation: plays the videos and images in a folder in turn, in order or shuffled, on a timer or with a shortcut.
  • Web wallpapers (experimental): Wallpaper Engine wallpapers of type web, rendered with the IDE's built-in Chromium (JCEF).
  • Readable code: opacity, blur and dim controls.
  • Light on resources: frames are decoded by a local ffmpeg process and kept in memory only, and playback pauses when the IDE loses focus or enters power save mode.

Get started from Tools | Live Background.

About ffmpeg: video and image backgrounds need ffmpeg. If none is installed, the plugin offers to download a minimal, decode-only LGPL build of ffmpeg (3–5 MB) from the project's GitHub releases. Nothing is downloaded until you click the download button. The file's SHA-256 checksum is verified, and it is stored in the folder shared by all JetBrains IDEs. The build script and ffmpeg sources are published with each release.


把视频当作 IDE 的背景播放，可以铺满整个窗口，也可以只在编辑器里。支持图片、文件夹轮播，以及 Wallpaper Engine 的网页壁纸（实验性）。可以调透明度、模糊和压暗；解码交给本机的 ffmpeg，帧只在内存里， IDE 失去焦点时自动暂停。没装 ffmpeg 时，可以一键下载插件专用的精简版（只解码、LGPL、3–5 MB， 下载后校验 SHA-256），不点按钮不会下载。从 Tools | Live Background 菜单开始使用。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
First release.

  • Video and image backgrounds for the whole window or the editors only.
  • Folder rotation with timer, shuffle and shortcuts.
  • Wallpaper Engine web wallpapers (experimental).
  • One-click download of a minimal ffmpeg when none is installed.
